CHy.source:
function CHy takes nothing returns nothing
local player iF=Player(Wl)
local integer iH=Wn
local integer iG=Wo
local integer VU=LZ[GetPlayerId(iF)]
local real EN
local real JS
local unit Cm
local integer EK=0
if WV then
set EN=WW
set JS=WX
else
set EN=GetPlayerStartLocationX(iF)
set JS=GetPlayerStartLocationY(iF)
endif
loop
exitwhen EK==iG
set Cm=CreateUnit(iF,iH,EN,JS,bj_UNIT_FACING)
if GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48303939 or GetUnitTypeId(Cm)==$48304232 then
call BH0(VU,Cm,$48303854)
else
call BH1(VU,Cm)
endif
call GroupAddUnit(Q6,Cm)
set EK=EK+1
endloop
set iF=null
set Cm=null
endfunction

BH0.source:
function BH0 takes integer VU,unit Cm,integer Mt returns boolean
if not Lb[VU] then
return false
endif
if IsUnitInGroup(Cm,Lc[VU]) then
return false
endif
if not HaveSavedHandle(VV,VU,Mt) then
call SaveGroupHandle(VV,VU,Mt,CreateGroup())
endif
call GroupAddUnit(Lc[VU],Cm)
call GroupAddUnit(LoadGroupHandle(VV,VU,Mt),Cm)
return true
endfunction
